svg.aria-label: Scatter chart of 2,112 films: IMDb rating against the share of the script's dialogue said word for word on screen. The median rises with the rating: 30% for films rated under 6, 38% for films rated 6 to 7, 47% for films rated 7 to 8, 50% for films rated 8 and up. There are big exceptions both ways, like Interstellar (rated 8.7, 9% kept) and Bridesmaids (6.8, 6%).

circle.title: Battlefield Earth (2000): rated 2.5, 17% of the script kept
Bridesmaids (2011): rated 6.8, 6% of the script kept
Interstellar (2014): rated 8.7, 9% of the script kept
The Princess Bride (1987): rated 8, 97% of the script kept
